Competition Structure

FORMULA STUDENT COMPETITION EVENTS

Formula Student evaluates race cars across 1,000 total points divided into Static & Dynamic Events.

Dynamic (75 Points)

75m Acceleration

Evaluates pure straight-line acceleration and launch control from a standing start over 75 meters.

3.2 SECONDS
Dynamic (75 Points)

Skidpad Cornering

Measures maximum steady-state cornering lateral G-force on a constant radius figure-8 track.

1.85 G LATERAL
Dynamic (100 Points)

Autocross Track

Tests driver maneuverability, chassis responsiveness, and suspension agility on a tight circuit.

TOP QUALIFIER
Dynamic (325 Points)

22km Endurance & Efficiency

The ultimate reliability test pushing engine cooling, fuel/energy efficiency, and component durability over 22 kilometers.

MAX RELIABILITY
Static (150 Points)

Engineering Design Event

Judged by Formula 1 & automotive industry engineers on CAD modeling, FEA/CFD, and technical design rationale.

F1 JUDGES PANEL
Static (175 Points)

Business Plan & Cost Report

Teams pitch a business manufacturing model to corporate judges alongside a complete part-by-part cost analysis.
